lines.en: Emily's cousin kicked me out what why well when you're subletting an
apartment from your wife's cousin and then you get a divorce sometimes the
cousin suddenly wants his apartment back how can you do that didn't you sign a
lease who needs a lease when it's family hey you can stay with us anything you
need man but you have to promise me you will let us know the second you are
feeling better so that we can make fun of your hair okay thanks you guys I
really appreciate this all right I'm gonna get packing again I've been moving
around so much lately I'm beginning to feel like a nomad what he thought you
